question: Does a free SearchApi account receive its 100 free requests once, or every month? With a free account (email sign-up, no card), call GET /api/v1/me and note account.monthly_allowance, account.remaining_credits and whether subscription.period_end is present; read what the dashboard shows for the free plan; call it again after the month turns or ask the vendor's support.
why: No public first-party page states the cadence. The pricing, home, sign-up, terms, privacy, docs, announcements and vendor example-app pages read on 2026-11-01 say 'Sign up for 100 free requests', 'newly registered users can test our platform with 100 complimentary searches' and 'Sign up for a free plan', with no cadence. Third-party pages disagree: webscraping.cc states one-time and three READMEs or package pages state 100 searches a month. The answer is behind a sign-up, so it is an operator step. It decides the verdict: trial-only if one-time, qualifies-with-caveat if monthly, and the chaining text, which says one-time, follows it.
